messages:
alex.sre: Quick heads-up: scheduling a routing + SLO rebalance rehearsal for Mon 2026-06-14 02:30-03:10 UTC in ap-southeast-1. Purpose: validate new admission control thresholds + smart-router weight adjustments under mild congestion.

priya.platform: What's the user-facing risk?

alex.sre: Low. We'll start with a 1% hosted canary and conservative weight shifts. Expected effect: transient P95 blips (100-250ms) for a small traffic slice. No planned errors. We'll have automated rollback triggers.

marta.prod: Can we ensure dedicated pools are not impacted by smart-router weight changes?

alex.sre: Yes dedicated pools are excluded by policy; canary targets hosted-tier only. We'll tag traffic group=canary-hosted.

devops-bot: Rehearsal job queued: job_id=route-rebalance-1976543210, canary=1%

bench-bot: Preflight synthetic: `benchctl run --region ap-southeast-1 --qps 800 --routes /v1/generate --duration 300 --tag rehearsal-1976543210`

alex.sre: Plan: 1) preflight canary 1% for 10m, 2) adjust smart-router weights (-10% to hot nodes) for 5m, 3) observe 10m, 4) small admission decrease test (lower admission thresholds by 15%) for 5m, 5) revert and verify.

priya.platform: Abort criteria?

alex.sre: Abort if any of: gen-api error-rate increases >0.5% absolute; sustained P95 delta >350ms for 8m; or admission queue length >1000 for 5m. If abort -> stop job, revert weights, run rollback admission script.

alex.sre: Rollback commands (runbook snippet):
```
# revert smart-router weights
curl -X POST https://internal-config/smartroute -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"region":"ap-southeast-1","rollback_tag":"rehearsal-1976543210"}'
# restore admission thresholds
kubectl -n inference apply -f configs/admission-defaults.yaml
```

infra-bot: Capacity check: ap-southeast-1 hosted pools show 13% spare CPU headroom and 20% GPU spare 1 OK for canary.

marta.prod: I'll queue smoke tests against SDKs after each phase. Also will prepare a short support blurb.

priya.platform: I'll add temporary dashboard tabs: route-weight-shifts, admission-queue, gen-api-p95-by-canary. Alerts set to abort criteria.

alex.sre: Owners: I'll drive the rehearsal, Priya watches dashboards, Marta owns smoke tests and support comms. Bench-bot will post perf summaries.

devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m before.

alex.sre: If any app team wants to opt-out their routes from the canary, DM me before Sun 23:59 UTC. We'll post to #status only if we abort or see >5m customer-visible impacts. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
